name: Turn YouTube Comments Into Audience Demand & Content Ideas with AI

parameters.content:
## Turn YouTube Comments Into Audience Demand & Content Ideas with AI

### How it works

This workflow starts from a research form, normalizes the submitted YouTube video input, and retrieves video metadata plus comments from the YouTube Data API. It packages the video and comment data for an AI agent, which uses Gemini to infer audience demand, pain points, questions, and content opportunities. The workflow then builds an evidence-backed report and displays it back to the user in a form response.

### Setup steps

- Configure the YouTube Data API access used by the HTTP Request nodes, including a valid API key or credential with permission to call video and commentThreads endpoints.
- Configure the Google Gemini credential/model used by the AI Agent's Google Gemini Chat Model sub-node.
- Review the form fields in "YouTube Research Form" so they collect the expected YouTube URL or video ID and any research options required by the normalization code.
- Verify the code nodes' assumptions for input field names, API response structure, comment limits, and report formatting before running with production data.

### Customization

You can adjust the number of comments fetched, the fields included in the AI research packet, the Gemini model or prompt, and the final report structure to match different content strategy frameworks.

## Collect research input

Captures the user's YouTube research request and normalizes/configures the submitted video information for downstream API calls.

## Fetch YouTube data

Retrieves the target video's details and comment thread data, then prepares a consolidated research packet for AI analysis.

## Analyze audience demand

Uses the AI Agent with the connected Google Gemini chat model to analyze the prepared comments and video context for audience demand signals and content ideas.

## Build and show report

Transforms the AI analysis into an evidence-backed report and presents the finished output to the user.

nodes.name: When Form Submitted
nodes.notes: START: built-in n8n form. No form vendor is required.

parameters.formDescription: =Paste a public YouTube video URL and uncover recurring viewer problems, requests, content opportunities, and product ideas from real comments.

nodes.name: Prepare Video Data
nodes.notes: Extracts the YouTube ID, clamps comment count to 25–100, and centralizes the OpenAI model.

nodes.name: Fetch Video Details
nodes.notes: Attach a Query Auth credential with Name=key and Value=your YouTube Data API v3 key. Public-data read only; no channel OAuth.

nodes.name: Fetch Comment Threads
nodes.notes: Uses one commentThreads.list call, capped at 100 threads. No Apify/Bright Data/scraper required.

nodes.name: Prepare Comments Data
nodes.notes: Cleans spam, deduplicates comments, ranks evidence, creates C001-style evidence IDs, and prepares a compact AI dataset.

nodes.name: Generate Research Report
nodes.notes: Validates evidence IDs against the actual collected comments and builds the final HTML report plus machine-readable JSON.

nodes.name: Display Report Form
nodes.notes: Displays the report immediately after the analysis finishes.

options.systemMessage:
=You are an evidence-first YouTube audience researcher.

Use ONLY the supplied comments. Find recurring questions, problems, complaints, feature requests, objections, purchase intent and tutorial requests.

Never invent demand. One evidence_id = one comment mention. Use author names only to estimate unique commenters.

Likes/replies are engagement context, not proof of willingness to pay.

Never invent quotes. Every signal and opportunity must cite supplied evidence_ids.

Separate repeated signals from one-off comments. Add caveats when evidence is weak.

Return concise, actionable JSON.
